mechanism_narrative: A continued decline in WORKPLACES signals weakening weekday trip generation, which reduces incidental shopping and lunch trips and pulls RETAIL_REC down over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall relative to the prior four-week mean after two consecutive weeks of lower WORKPLACES mobility.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated above its recent mean, discretionary outings are displaced toward home-based activity, so retail visits remain suppressed and RETAIL_REC trends lower within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above +5 for at least 2 consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or stays above its last-four-week average during a period when RESIDENTIAL remains above +5 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES increases access to shopping districts and converts commuting flows into retail stops, pushing RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve despite both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES trending upward for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If transit mobility drops sharply, especially alongside falling workplaces activity, access friction rises and retail trips are delayed or canceled, causing RETAIL_REC to weaken within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by more than 5 points week-on-week while WORKPLACES also declines
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not drop in the week after a simultaneous transit and workplace decline of the specified size.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GROCERY_PHARM reflects substitution toward essential trips, which crowds out discretionary retail demand and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next two weeks while GROCERY_PHARM stays above its recent four-week average.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility is elevated relative to its own recent level, outdoor leisure competes with shopping time and diverts discretionary footfall away from retail and recreation venues, lowering RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -15 after being below -20 in the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not weaken after PARKS crosses above -15 from a lower base and remains elevated for at least two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime where workplace mobility is falling but residential mobility is rising, people are staying local yet avoiding discretionary trips, so retail traffic declines over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES falling and RESIDENTIAL remaining above its prior four-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in TRANSIT after a weak week signals renewed cross-city circulation; if WORKPLACES does not simultaneously deteriorate, that rebound feeds retail footfall and lifts RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT turns positive week-on-week from a near-flat base
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within two weeks after TRANSIT turns positive while WORKPLACES remains no worse than -10.
